title: Code.org Coach Training: Mid-Year Check-in Survey

elements.name: intro
elements.html:
Code.org Professional Learning for Coaches

Thank you for being part of the Code.org Coach Network pilot!

Mid-Year Check-in Survey

This short survey will help us understand how we can better support Code.org Coaches and strengthen the Coach Network moving forward.

Privacy and Confidentiality

  • Your individual responses here are completely confidential.
  • Your identity will never be revealed publicly or used to tie any responses back to you personally.
  • We may share de-identified, aggregate data (representing all responses) publicly.
  • Your de-identified responses will be used by Code.org, our Regional Partners, and our facilitators for program improvement.

Your honesty and candor are appreciated.

Post-Workshop Survey

elements.name: number_teachers_supported
elements.title: Approximately how many individual teachers have you supported through coaching activities this school year?
elements.description: Please count teachers you have directly supported through workshops, PLCs, 1:1 coaching, modeling, or other CS or AI-related implementation support.

choices.text: 0 - None

elements.name: coaching_support_methods
elements.title: How have you provided coaching support?

choices.text: Large-group professional development sessions or workshops
1:1 coaching conversations
Professional Learning Communities (PLCs)
Classroom modeling and/or co-teaching
Informal “just-in-time” support (e.g., quick check-ins, planning support)

elements.name: content_areas
elements.title: What content areas or initiatives have your coaching sessions focused on?

choices.text: K–5 Code.org courses (e.g., Computer Science Fundamentals, Computer Science Connections)
6–8 Code.org courses (e.g., Computer Science Discoveries)
Hour of Code / Hour of AI
AI for Teachers
Introductory computer science concepts for teachers new to CS
Supporting implementation planning (e.g., scheduling, materials, pacing)

elements.name: supports
elements.title: What has been most helpful to enable your coaching work so far?

choices.text: Strong district-level administrator support
Strong school-level administrator support
Teacher enthusiasm and buy-in
A district-wide computer science and/or AI initiative
A state-wide computer science and/or AI mandate
Dedicated time for coaching or professional development

elements.name: barriers
elements.title: What have been the biggest obstacles to implementing a Coach Program in your district/region?

choices.text: Lack of district-level administrator support or buy-in
Lack of school-level administrator support or buy-in
Lack of teacher buy-in or confidence
Competing district initiatives or priorities
Limited funding or resources

elements.name: additional_support
elements.title: What additional support would help you most in the second half of the year?

elements.name: other_feedback
elements.title: Is there anything else you’d like to share about your experience as a Code.org Coach so far?
elements.description: You might consider sharing a short success story or a challenge you are navigating

elements.name: permission_to_quote
elements.title: I give Code.org permission to quote my written comments from this survey for use on social media, promotional materials, and other communications.

choices.text: Yes, I give the workshop organizer permission to quote me and use my name.
Yes, I give the workshop organizer permission to quote me, but I want to be anonymous.
No, I do not give the workshop organizer my permission.

elements.name: participate_focus_group
elements.title: OPTIONAL: Would you be willing to participate in a follow-up discussion to provide direct feedback about your experience as a Code.org coach so far?
